summary_statement: ADV-001 reuses identical mutation operators, distance metrics, mutability masks, and Blue model definitions, but evaluates across a wider stratified population (50 candidate transactions, 10,000 attempts) rather than EXP-007-A's 10 selected source transactions (200 attempts).

attack_families.detail: Both evaluate the exact 5 canonical families: burst_drain, slow_siphon, geo_hop, agent_subversion, cross_merchant_fanout

feature_masks.detail: Both enforce FAMILY_MUTABLE_FIELDS and IMMUTABLE_FIELDS via check_mask_violations

query_semantics.detail: Both treat each evaluated mutation candidate as a single black-box query

target_transactions.detail: EXP-007-A evaluated 10 source transactions; ADV-001 sampled across 50 blocked/challenged transactions to support 10,000 attempts

blue_model_version.detail: Both evaluate against unhardened baseline LightGBM Blue detector

normalization.detail: Normalized continuous deltas + categorical Hamming distance

success_definition.detail: Successful evasion defined strictly as final_decision == Decision.ALLOW

temporal_state.detail: Both evaluate streaming feature states at transaction timestamp without future leakage

world_state.detail: Both generated under tiny synthetic world with seed 20260827

seed_semantics.detail: EXP-007-A used seed 20260827 offset per instance; ADV-001 used derived master seed 20260831

med_comparability.explanation: ADV-001 MED=1.2032 reflects successful evasions solely from geo_hop (600 successful evasions), whereas EXP-007-A MED=2.8488 reflected successful evasions across agent_subversion and burst_drain on 10 source cases.
